quote: I used to chase the shadows in my mind. I thought the darkness would eventually reveal some truth. I waited for the silence to finally speak to me. But the empty rooms only gave back my own breathing. We spend years searching for answers that never arrive. Sometimes the greatest wisdom is simply learning how to rest.
